name: hkaomua-slide-template
description: LINE Seed JP slide templates for Marp, Beamer, and Typst

scripts.html: npm run theme && marp slides.md --output slides.html
scripts.pdf: npm run theme && marp slides.md --pdf --allow-local-files --output slides.pdf
scripts.build: npm run html && npm run pdf
scripts.watch: npm run theme && marp slides.md --watch --output slides.html
